jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. jobs.description: Job Description The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification. Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed. Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise. Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility. What You Will Need: Education and Experience Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work. Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required. Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities. Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work. Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions. Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others. Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide. We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s. We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire. About The Role You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture. This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when. You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this. What You'll Do Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no." Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. What You'll Bring Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. jobs.title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description: At Pflegia we build and operate an intelligent job matching platform that brings caregivers and healthcare employers together. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis. We are past the build-it phase. The constraint is no longer whether we can ship — it is deciding which of twenty possible things actually moves hires. That decision is the job. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market with us. Tasks What You'll Do Own the matching funnel end to end — invite, accepted match, transferred match, interview, hire. Every step is measured today and every step leaks. Analyze business requirements and break them down into roadmaps, timelines, epics, tickets and tasks — and defend the cut list. Document, analyze and improve the whole user journey on both sides of the marketplace: candidates and employers have competing interests, and those trade-offs are yours to make rather than escalate. Create actionable concepts for new products and features, estimate effort and ROI, own the process from ideation to delivery. Decide where AI belongs and where it does not. Run experiments with the expected outcome written down first, then verify and iterate. Define KPIs, track them, improve them, revise them. Within 90 days we expect one metric you moved, with a baseline, a number, and a read you can defend to the leadership team. Collaborate with stakeholders, developers and the data team, and use data-driven storytelling to align them. Requirements Must have 5+ years in Product Ownership/Management, shipping with cross-functional agile teams. Experience building or scaling marketplaces, job boards, or recruitment platforms — two-sided funnels behave differently and we would rather not teach that from scratch. Data-driven by default: you write your own analytics questions, read an experiment result, and say "this did not work" out loud. Analytics, A/B testing, experimentation. Strong ability to define product vision, roadmaps and priorities against business goals, customer needs and technical constraints — including clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for complicated workflows and funnels. Excellent written German and English. Our users, employers and support team are German-speaking; our codebase and documentation are English. Nice to have Search and SEO, including the AI-answer variants (AIEO, AEO, GEO) — a growing share of our traffic. Matching or recommendation systems: you know why offline metrics and business metrics disagree. Healthcare hiring workflows and empathy for the field — shift work, qualification recognition, and why a nurse does not read email at 14:00. SQL. Not required, but the people who enjoy this role usually have it. Benefits Decision authority. Flat hierarchies with short decision paths are not a slogan here: you will not need a committee to ship, and you will not get to blame one either. Direct access to the data — our own data lake, dashboards and product analytics. You query it yourself instead of filing a ticket and waiting. Budget and room for experiments that are allowed to fail, provided the expected outcome was defined up front. Regular feedback conversations with empathic and experienced leadership. An open corporate culture with helpful, communicative colleagues and a genuinely cooperative working atmosphere. Ein Download ist dabei erst der Anfang. Entscheidend ist, ob am Ende ein Transport stattfindet und die Person wiederkommt. Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du verantwortest Paid-Kanäle und denkst den ganzen Funnel mit, vom ersten Kontakt mit einer Ad bis zum abgeschlossenen Transport. Zum Start arbeitet dich unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager in alle unsere Tools und Workflows ein, die bei uns KI-first aufgebaut sind. Du bist nicht die Person, die nur Kosten pro Install drückt. Du willst verstehen, warum Nutzer:innen kommen, wo sie abspringen und welcher Hebel wirklich wirkt. Und du nutzt KI jeden Tag, um schneller zu testen, auszuwerten und zu bauen. Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.11. in Vollzeit als Verstärkung für unser Growth-Team in Hamburg 🚀 Aufgaben Paid-Kanäle verantworten Du steuerst unsere Kampagnen auf Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads und TikTok. Planung, Setup, Budget, tägliche Optimierung. Du entscheidest mit, wo der nächste Euro am meisten bringt. Den ganzen Funnel im Blick Download, Registrierung, erstes Transportgesuch, Match, abgeschlossener Transport, Wiederkehr. Du optimierst auf die Schritte, die für uns wirklich zählen. Mit Tech sorgst du dafür, dass diese Events sauber gemessen und an die Plattformen zurückgespielt werden. Zwei Seiten, eine Strategie Wir brauchen Versender:innen und Fahrer:innen, am besten auf denselben Strecken. Du erkennst, wo eine Seite fehlt, und steuerst Kampagnen nach Stadt, Strecke und Kategorie gezielt dagegen. Creative-Pipeline Du baust eine Pipeline auf, die unsere Ads dauerhaft frisch hält. Briefings, Hooks, UGC, KI-Varianten, Abstimmung mit Design und Content. Du weißt, welches Creative warum funktioniert. Testing-Programm Du testest systematisch statt nach Bauchgefühl. Von der Hypothese über das Setup bis zur sauberen Auswertung. Learnings dokumentierst du so, dass das ganze Team sie nutzen kann. KI und eigene Tools Du arbeitest KI-first. Mit Claude Code baust du dir eigene Tools für Auswertung, Reporting, Automatisierung und Creative-Varianten. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool. Performance sichtbar machen Du lieferst ein klares wöchentliches Reporting für Team und Gründer:innen. Nicht nur, was passiert ist, sondern was wir jetzt tun sollten. Trends und Plattform-Änderungen Neue Formate, Algorithmus-Updates, Veränderungen bei Tracking und Attribution. Du hast sie auf dem Schirm, bevor sie uns treffen, und leitest ab, was das für unsere Kampagnen bedeutet. Datenschnittstelle im Marketing Du wirst Ansprechperson für Datenfragen aus CRM, SEO und Social Media und verbindest die Zahlen zu einem Bild. Qualifikation Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing und dabei eigenständig Budget verantwortet. Idealerweise bei einer App, auf einem Marktplatz oder in einem schnell wachsenden Startup. Meta Ads und Google Ads kennst du in der Tiefe. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur aufgesetzt, sondern Account-Strukturen gebaut, Budgets über mehrere Kanäle gesteuert und auf Events jenseits des Installs optimiert. Erfahrung mit Apple Search Ads, TikTok, Mobile-Attribution und Tracking-Setups ist ein klares Plus. Was uns genauso wichtig ist wie Tool-Wissen: Du denkst in Funnels, nicht in Downloads. Ein günstiger Install, aus dem nie ein Transport wird, ist für dich kein Erfolg. Du arbeitest datenbasiert. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><img src="https://www.relexsolutions.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/relex-greenhouse-banner-top.png" alt="" width="1280" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div><p><strong>Who we are</strong><br>We're bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing – and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy – and we know we can't shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.</p> <p><strong>What we do</strong><br>RELEX Solutions delivers a unified supply chain planning platform for retailers and manufacturers, enabled by proven AI technology. We help companies optimize demand forecasting, replenishment, merchandising, pricing and promotions, supply chain operations, and production planning across the end-to-end value chain.</p> <p>With a global team of over 2,000 professionals, we work side-by-side with our customers to solve real problems with lasting impact. Companies trust RELEX to increase product availability, boost sales, deliver actionable insights, improve sustainability, and drive profitable growth. Join us and make an impact on the world and your career!</p> <p>In response to our fast growth and market expansion, we're looking for experienced Product Engineers to join our Supply Chain product teams: people who thrive at the intersection of customer problems, technical solutions, and business strategy, and who want to own outcomes from discovery through production.</p> <p><strong>What we need you to do and be</strong><br>Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.</p> <ul> <li>Own requirements end-to-end for your product area, from discovery through UAT and quality assurance, making sure what ships solves the real underlying problem, not just the stated ask.</li> <li>Own your deployed product and iterate fast: manage releases, gather structured customer feedback, and feed it back into the next iteration.</li> <li>Work closely with your Engineering Manager to translate customer needs and usage data into team-level priorities, keeping the roadmap grounded in real outcomes.</li> <li>Act as an industry and product expert in customer-facing settings, pushing back on stated requirements when the evidence points elsewhere, and supporting sales efforts such as scoping and feasibility.</li> <li>Validate that solutions genuinely meet customer expectations through ongoing quality gates and proactive expectation management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring to the table</strong><br>Our five values are our playbook. We speak up when things don't make sense. We stop doing what doesn't add value. We stay curious, back each other up, and make space for both innovation and laughter.</p> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of your customers' day-to-day work, goals, and pain points across an entire product area.</li> <li>Confidence to push back on stated customer needs when evidence points to a different solution, and experience mentoring other Product Engineers.</li> <li>Experience designing solutions to complex problems spanning data, AI/ML, UX, and system integration.</li> <li>Solid software engineering and DevOps skills, building and deploying solutions using RELEX's existing frameworks.</li> <li>Comfortable with using AI in your everyday work and developing the use of AI tools as a larger organizational strategy.</li> <li>Fluent in written and spoken English.</li&

Coding agents, LLMs and AI-assisted development are part of the daily workflow here, not a pilot project</li> <li>You set the standards: code quality benchmarks, development practices and CI/CD pipelines, agreed cross-functionally and enforced in review</li> <li>You mentor the engineers around you, share what you know, and raise the bar on backend practice</li> <li>You challenge how we work. When our approach is wrong, you say so and you bring the better one</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>What you bring</h3> <ul> <li>8+ years in software engineering, 5+ of them focused on backend</li> <li>Deep TypeScript proficiency, with strong Node.js, NestJS and PostgreSQL experience</li> <li>A proven mentorship track record: you have coached engineers and raised the standard around you</li> <li>Solid command of Git, Docker and CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Comfortable in Scrum or Kanban, working with JIRA and Confluence</li> <li>English at C1 level, written and spoken, for daily work with an international team</li> <li>AI-native working style: you use AI tools in your own development workflow and have real judgement about where they accelerate you and where they don't</li> <li>Based in Munich&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>WebSockets or other real-time systems</li> <li>Search frameworks such as Elasticsearch or Lucene</li> <li>Automotive or B2B trading background</li> <li>Conversational German</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>What to expect from us</h3> <ul> <li>25 "Work from Anywhere" days per year</li> <li>28 days annual leave</li> <li>2× annual career &amp; development conversations</li> <li>Company pension with 20% employer contribution</li> <li>Fully paid Deutschlandticket (public transport)</li> <li>FitX membership or Urban Sports Club subsidy</li> <li>Virtual stock options — share in the upside</li> <li>Modern IT setup for your day-to-day work</li> <li>Structured onboarding with buddy programme and social events</li> <li>Lived diversity: active women's network</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Apply now — your CV is enough.</strong></p> </div> </div> </div> </div&gt

One Profit Engine.</strong></em></p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>Deine Aufgaben</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung:</strong> Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unserer Inspection- und Dispatching-Prozesse und hilfst, sie effizienter und skalierbarer zu machen.</li> <li><strong>Datenbasierte Analyse:</strong> Du unterstützt bei der Analyse bestehender Abläufe, etwa Routeneffizienz, Termin-Auslastung und Qualitätsraten, und hilfst, Verbesserungsmaßnahmen abzuleiten.</li> <li><strong>KI und Automatisierung:</strong> Du lernst unsere KI-Tools kennen und wirkst beim Aufbau von Automatisierungen und Agents mit, die echte operative Probleme lösen.</li> <li><strong>Reporting:</strong> Du hilfst beim Erstellen von Präsentationen und Reportings, mit denen Performance-Kennzahlen und strategische Initiativen ans Management gehen.</li> <li><strong>Teamarbeit:</strong> Du arbeitest eng mit Team-Leads, Disponenten und dem Ops-Management zusammen und begleitest laufende Projekte.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>Was du mitbringst</h3> <p><strong>Must-have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Studium in BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Logistik, Data oder einem verwandten Bereich, oder Abschluss bereits in der Tasche</li> <li>Analytisches und strukturiertes Denken kombiniert mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität</li> <li>Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen und Daten; jobs.description: Who is Seyond?     Seyond is a leading global provider of image-grade LiDAR technology, powering a safer, smarter and more mobile world across the automotive, intelligent transportation, robotics and industrial automation sectors. Founded in Silicon Valley with strategically placed research and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Seyond is crafting LiDAR solutions that elevate autonomous driving and fuel the advancement of smart infrastructure development. Our dynamic portfolio – including ultra-long range flagship LiDAR sensor Falcon, mid-to-short range LiDAR sensor Robin and perception service software platform OmniVidi – powers automotive and ITS solutions for partners like NIO, Faraday Future, Exwayz and Hexagon. The Role We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. This is a player-coach role. Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales. Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection. Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers. Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline. Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings. Partner with SIMPL's European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities. Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning. Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking. Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries. jobs.title: Minijob: Digitale Belegprüfung (w/m/d)
jobs.description: SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert. Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich. Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis – digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst. Der Unterschied zu anderen „Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen – und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Die Rolle in einem Satz Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserer KI: Du kontrollierst, was sie vorschlägt, übernimmst die Fälle, an die sie noch nicht herankommt, und entwickelst sie mit jedem Fall weiter. Eine steuerfachliche Vorbildung brauchst du dafür nicht. Deine Aufgaben 1. Du bist die Kontrollinstanz zwischen Daten und Automatisierung Unsere KI liest Belege aus, ordnet sie Bankumsätzen zu und schlägt die Verarbeitung vor. Du prüfst diese Vorschläge: Rechnungsangaben, Steuerausweis, Zeitraum, Zuordnung zum Mandanten. Du bestätigst, korrigierst oder verwirfst. Du erkennst, wo die Erkennung systematisch danebenliegt: bestimmte Belegtypen, Lieferanten, Fremdwährungen, Formate. 2. Du übernimmst, was die KI noch nicht kann Unklare Zahlungspartner, widersprüchliche Zuordnungen, Sonderfälle ohne Vorlage – alles, was sich nicht automatisch auflöst, landet bei dir. Du recherchierst den Sachverhalt und entscheidest ihn im Rahmen unserer Prüfkriterien; alles, was eine steuerliche Beurteilung erfordert, geht an einen Berufsträger. Je besser die Automatisierung wird, desto anspruchsvoller werden die Fälle, die bei dir landen. Die Rolle wird dadurch nicht kleiner, sondern fachlicher. 3. Du klärst mit den Mandanten Du forderst fehlende Belege an – schriftlich, konkret und mit Frist. Das läuft asynchron, also unabhängig davon, wann du arbeitest. Du verfolgst offene Punkte bis zur Erledigung nach, damit die BWA bis zum 15. steht, und erklärst verständlich, warum ein Beleg nicht ausreicht. 4. Du machst die KI besser Du meldest wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder: Was passiert, wie oft, was sollte stattdessen passieren. Deine Hinweise gehen direkt an Engineering und Design – mit Rückmeldung, was daraus geworden ist. Dein Profil Must-have Analytisches Denken: Du erkennst Muster und Abweichungen in Daten, ziehst aus Einzelfällen die richtigen Schlüsse und kannst begründen, warum etwas nicht stimmt. Verlässliche Qualität bei hoher Fallzahl: Du arbeitest gründlich, auch wenn die KI in den meisten Fällen richtig liegt – gerade dann fallen die Ausnahmen leicht durchs Raster. Verbindlichkeit statt Dauererreichbarkeit: Was du zusagst, ist im vereinbarten Zeitraum erledigt. Wann du es erledigst, entscheidest du. Interesse an KI und Automatisierung: Du willst verstehen, warum ein System etwas vorschlägt, und nicht nur, was es vorschlägt. Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets und digitalen Tools; Lust, dich in neue Software einzuarbeiten. Klare, freundliche schriftliche Kommunikation auf Deutsch (C1/C2) – der Mandantenkontakt läuft überwiegend schriftlich. Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz und stabiles Internet für deine Arbeitsblöcke. Nice-to-have Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du weißt, wie ein Geschäftsvorfall von der Rechnung bis zur Zahlung läuft. Erste Berührung mit Buchhaltung, Rechnungswesen, DATEV oder kaufmännischer Sachbearbeitung – auch wenn sie Jahre zurückliegt. Erfahrung aus einem Umfeld mit hohem Datenvolumen (Operations, Backoffice, Support, Fulfillment, Payment). Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools: Prompts, Formeln, Filter, einfache Automatisierungen.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Data Operations and Analytics (all genders)
jobs.description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by! 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! We're looking for a savvy Senior Analyst, Data Operations & Analytics to join our Data Office in Berlin and serve as the ultimate bridge between data, product, and business teams across our Hospitality vertical. You'll turn complex business questions into clear insights, reusable data models, and reporting that help teams understand their customers and business, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. If you're ready to combine strong analytical judgment, product and business understanding, and technical expertise to elevate data standards, and make a lasting impact, this is the opportunity for you! Lightspeed empowers the businesses at the heart of our communities, from standout retailers to unforgettable restaurants to renowned golf courses. We are a global team who fuel ambitions with technology and insight. From online and in-person operations to multichannel sales, payments, inventory management and data-driven insights, Lightspeed helps businesses grow, deliver exceptional customer experiences and run smarter across all channels and locations. Join our driven, diverse and inclusive team to find your people, accelerate your career and create tangible solutions that help local businesses thrive. What you'll be responsible for: Develop a deep understanding of Hospitality’s business processes, systems, customers, and underlying data architecture to provide meaningful analysis and support operational excellence within the Pod. Wir verbinden unsere eigene AI-Software mit der Expertise erfahrener Profis und einem starken operativen Team, das dir den Rücken frei hält. Deine Rolle: Strategischer Fokus statt Admin-Chaos Du arbeitest bei uns strategischer als in klassischen Verwaltungen. Du bist der/die souveräne Ansprechpartner:in für Beiräte, während unsere Struktur dir den administrativen Wahnsinn abnimmt: Support: Ein Customer Success Team beantwortet Tickets und Standard-Anfragen für dich. Technik: Ein Instandhaltungs-Team übernimmt die Handwerker-Koordination. Backoffice: Ein Buchhaltungs-Team hält die Zahlen und Abrechnungen sauber. AI: Unsere Software automatisiert die Dokumentation und das Daily Business. Deine Mission Beirats-Management: Du pflegst die Beziehungen zu den Beiräten und führst deine Gemeinschaften souverän durch das Jahr. Versammlungsleitung: Du moderierst hybride und digitale Eigentümerversammlungen mit unserer hauseigenen Software. Innovation: Du bist die Schnittstelle zum Produkt-Team und hilfst uns, die Software so zu bauen, dass sie Verwaltern das Leben rettet. Wachstum (Optional): Du hast Lust, neue Kunden zu begeistern? Zertifizierung: Du bist „Zertifizierter Verwalter“ (§ 26a WEG) oder hast eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Ownership: Du hast keine Lust mehr auf „Dienst nach Vorschrift“, sondern willst Prozesse aktiv neu denken. Kommunikation: Du trittst sicher auf und überzeugst Beiräte durch Kompetenz und Verbindlichkeit. Was du bei Ralph bekommst Echte Freiheit: Wir sind "Remote-first" . Egal ob Hamburg, Berlin oder ein Coffee-Shop – du arbeitest, von wo du willst. Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Vertrag in einem stabilen, VC-finanzierten PropTech mit 10.000 Einheiten im Rücken. Entwicklung: Wir fördern deine Spezialisierung zum Klimaverwalter . Extras: Attraktives Fixum plus erfolgsabhängiger Bonus, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und regelmäßige Team-Offsites. jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Greif mit uns nach den Sternen! Zur Unterstützung unseres Finance-Teams bei Limehome suchen wir eine:n motivierte:n Werkstudent:in Finance & Accounting (m/w/d). Du unterstützt primär unser Accounting-Team im Tagesgeschäft und bei den Monatsabschlüssen und bekommst je nach Bedarf darüber hinaus Einblicke in weitere Finance-Themen wie Reporting, FP&A und Prozessautomatisierung. So lernst du eine moderne, tech-getriebene Finanzfunktion in einem international wachsenden Unternehmen von Grund auf kennen und übernimmst früh Verantwortung. Als ‘Host with heart’ bist du für diese Themen verantwortlich: Du unterstützt das Accounting-Team im Tagesgeschäft, zum Beispiel in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung (z. B. Rechnungserfassung, Kontenabstimmung, Belegmanagement). Du hilfst bei vorbereitenden Tätigkeiten für die Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse mit. Du unterstützt bei der Aufbereitung von Daten und Auswertungen, z. B. für Reportings oder Ad-hoc Anfragen. Du wirkst an der Verbesserung und Automatisierung von Finance-Prozessen mit – inkl. dem Einsatz von Tools und KI. Du übernimmst eigenständig je nach Bedarf kleinere Projekte und Ad-hoc-Aufgaben über den gesamten Finance-Bereich hinweg. Was Du brauchst, um mit uns nach den Sternen zu greifen: Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in, idealerweise mit wirtschaftswissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt (z. B. BWL, Finance, Accounting, Wirtschaftsinformatik). Du bringst eine sorgfältige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit und arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen. Du hast eine Affinität für Prozesse, Tools und Systeme und Interesse an Automatisierung und KI Du bist proaktiv, lernbereit und übernimmst gerne früh Verantwortung. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift. Du kannst uns idealerweise für etwa 16-20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen (flexibel in der Prüfungszeit). Darum wirst du deinen “Aufenthalt” bei uns lieben: Onboarding und Feedback: Wir sorgen mit unserem gut durchdachten Onboarding-Prozess für einen reibungslosen Start. Regelmäßiges Feedback und Peer Reviews unterstützen dich zusätzlich in deiner Weiterentwicklung.  OneTeam: Eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit Team-Stand-ups, regelmäßigen All-Hands-Meetings und Firmenevents (Sommerparty, Wiesn,...). jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Berlin Mitte · Hybrid (up to 2 days/week remote) · €60,000–75,000 + VSOP equity Help us decarbonize cement and concrete - not tomorrow, today alcemy is on a mission to keep 100 million tons of CO₂ out of the atmosphere every year by 2030. Making concrete accounts for around 8% of global CO₂ emissions, and our machine-learning software runs inside cement and concrete plants 24/7 to cut it - without sacrificing quality or driving up costs. We're already live in a third of Germany's cement plants and 30+ ready-mix concrete plants. The role You'll own the systems that get plant data into alcemy. That data comes from external partners, and it arrives messy. You'll build and own the APIs and services that take it in, make sense of it, and feed the machine-learning models behind our recommendations - designing those systems, deploying them, keeping them running, and diagnosing what went wrong when something upstream changes without warning. It's a backend engineering role with a data problem at the centre of it, and it's refreshingly hands-on with customers: you'll dig into real-world data, explain what you find to non-technical people, and make getting data into alcemy dramatically easier. What you need is solid production Python, the ability to run what you build, and comfort talking to the people on the other end of the pipe. What you'll do Own the data ingestion systems that bring messy plant data from external partners into something our ML can use Build and improve our ingestion APIs, moving us from strict, structured data requirements toward flexible, AI-powered ingestion — so customers onboard with far less friction Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot your systems in production, diagnosing and fixing issues when something upstream changes without warning Track down data anomalies and explain your findings to customers in plain language Build and maintain the APIs and PostgreSQL databases behind our products, and keep production running smoothly Work shoulder to shoulder with external partners, customers, sales and customer success - translating between the technical and the non-technical Collaborate with the product team on backend work Requirements You'll thrive here if... above all, you care about climate change and want your work to count. Must-haves You've deployed production-grade Python applications You know how to deploy, monitor and troubleshoot production systems in a cloud environment You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you collaborate well across roles You're comfortable working directly with customers, sales and customer success - patient, plain-spoken, and at ease with non-technical enterprise teams You pick up unfamiliar codebases quickly, and you're keen to contribute early You're open to using AI tools to augment how you work Nice-to-haves Exposure to machine learning or data pipeline projects Experience with FastAPI, Flask or Django PostgreSQL or similar SQL databases Experience designing or maintaining integrations with third-party or partner systems Don't tick every box? We'd still love to hear from you. How we work You won't be working alone - you'll build collaboratively alongside senior and junior engineers, owning features end to end: build, test, review, deploy. Small team, direct customer exposure, fast startup pace - so async communication, clear prioritisation, transparency, and direct feedback are the norm, and how we work is something we shape together, and keep improving. We use Claude Code responsibly: AI to move fast, engineers always in charge and accountable, no AI-slop merge requests. We'll ask you to be flexible. We don't have fixed teams or fixed projects here. As the business shifts, we'll ask you to move to where the work matters most and pick up new problems. If you enjoy variety and switching between problems, you'll do well here. Hybrid by design (Berlin Mitte office, up to 2 days remote, plus offsites and boat trips), with real room to grow along technical-expert

jobs.title: Legal Specialist Tech & Data (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Overview NEON is a highly specialized business law firm providing advice at the highest level. We embrace shared entrepreneurship, are more than just colleagues, and love what we do. Our teams – including Venture Capital, Private Equity, Litigation, Real Estate, Tax, and Tech & Data – deliver holistic advice and work closely together. Our focus is on the legal support of entrepreneurial projects – from investments and transactions to the development of new business models, the structuring of complex commercial arrangements, and the legal enablement of digital innovation. Our Tech & Data Team advises national and international clients on legal issues relating to data protection, IT law, AI, digital business models and the regulatory requirements of an increasingly digital economy. We help innovative companies navigate complex legal frameworks and enable technological progress through practical legal advice. Are you looking for a position that allows you to pursue your legal career ambitions while benefiting from predictable working hours and more time for your personal life? We offer a great alternative. To join our team, we are looking for a Your mission You are passionate about the intersection of law andtechnology and want to deepen your legal expertise in these areas. As a Legal Specialist in our Tech & Data team, you will work on a broad range of matters relating to data protection, IT law, artificial intelligence and digital business models and take ownership of legal tasks to actively contribute to the successful delivery of our client matters. Working closely with a highly specialized team, you will gain insight into some of the most dynamic developments at the intersection of law, technology and business. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer arbeitest du im Pricing & Revenue-Kontext an datengetriebenen Verbesserungen für Forecasting, Pricing-Logiken und Produkt-Insights. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start. The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Platform Operations and Service Ownership  Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D)
jobs.description: The ILF Solar Photovoltaic & hybrid systems team works across a vast range of large-scale renewables projects and programs, both grid connected and off-grid across private and public sectors globally. We offer you to join a dynamic environment and to work on unique and exciting projects (including floating PV, complex hybrid systems, combination with Hydrogen, rural electrification, etc.). Join our Team in Munich or Fontainebleau / Paris to contribute to the transition toward a decarbonized and sustainable energy future! We are looking for a Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D) YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: You will operate as a Senior Project Manager - Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) for strategic projects worldwide. Your clients will include International Finance Institutions (AFD, KfW, World Bank, EBRD, EIB, etc.), national power utilities, major private clients (industrial, project developers, etc.). During development phase of the projects, you will lead Feasibility studies of complex power plant systems including system sizing / optimization, CAPEX and OPEX estimation, conceptual / detail design and layout, grid studies (PSS/E, Power Factory), energy master plan studies (PLEXOS, PyPSA), etc. Your activities could also include to lead TDD, LTA as well as Technical Transaction Advisor projects. During implementation phase , you will lead the tender design, evaluation of EPC/IPP offers, reviewing and validating the executive design before construction (design vetting). Your will also be overseeing the supervision of the construction, commissioning and O&M phase. As an interface between suppliers, IPP / EPC contractors and clients you keep up to date with and pass on market trends, technology development, new products, standards and simulation models. Your engineering skills will contribute to the standardization of work processes with the goal of enhancing efficiency and quality. You will also support the development of our international activities by preparing proposals and supporting business development initiatives. YOUR QUALIFICATIONS: Graduated in the field of energy, electrical engineering or similar with a focus on Renewable Energies / Photovoltaics / Energy Storage Systems (ESS). At least 10 years of experience in large scale photovoltaic & battery systems with robust project management and engineering skills. Expertise in Wind and Green Hydrogen projects would be a plus. Experience with Energy software such as PVSyst, HOMER PRO, and/or Power system Software (Power Factory, PSS/E) is required. Understanding of technical aspects of PPA and EPC contracts regarding performance and penalties is required. Excellent writing skills Very good written and spoken skills in English and in French. 91% of our employees consider ILF Germany & France a “Great Place to Work”.   Friendly company culture and diversity in everyday practice Numerous local and cross-regional events strengthen team spirit, and the majority of our employees address each other on a first-name basis. We are particularly proud of the international diversity of our teams, which bring together more than 30 nationalities. Modern working environment Across all our locations, our employees benefit from modern, high-quality workstations, including height-adjustable desks. High intensity team, high challenge, high worker and learned. jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
tags: liris - laboratoire d'informatique en image et systèmes d'information
jobs.description: PROJECT OVERVIEW We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly. Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy. That's what we are building 🤖🏥. 🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. As their engineering leader, you own: 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own. ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well. 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions. 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out. If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab. Your tasks Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers. Responsibilities: You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager / Meta Ads (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wer sind wir? Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. Aus dieser Mission ist Finanzklar entstanden. Denn Wissen allein reicht nicht – die meisten Menschen scheitern nicht am Verstehen, sondern an der Umsetzung. Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir helfen ganz konkret dabei, die richtigen Finanzentscheidungen zu treffen. Ohne Provisionslogik gegen den Kunden. Ohne undurchsichtige Produkte. Sondern mit echter, unabhängiger Beratung. Unsere Mission: Gute Finanzentscheidungen dürfen nicht länger nur den Experten überlassen sein – wir demokratisieren sie. Und dafür suchen wir dich. Als Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) entscheidest du mit darüber, ob Menschen Finanzklar überhaupt kennenlernen. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der nicht einfach Anzeigen schaltet, sondern versteht warum manche Kampagnen Menschen bewegen und andere nicht. Aufgaben Du planst, schaltest und optimierst unsere Meta-Ads-Kampagnen – von der Zielgruppe über das Budget bis zur täglichen Auswertung der Zahlen. Parallel entwickelst du die Creatives dazu: Anzeigenbilder, Videos und Texte, die unsere Botschaft transportieren. Du bringst zwei Dinge zusammen: Du analysierst Zahlen und verstehst, was sie bedeuten – und du entwickelst daraus Bilder und Texte, die Menschen wirklich ansprechen. Deine Aufgaben im Detail: Eigenständige Planung, Aufbau und Steuerung von Meta Ads Kampagnen (Facebook & Instagram) – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung Verwaltung und Optimierung von Werbebudgets mit klarem Fokus auf messbaren Ergebnissen (CPL, CTR, ROAS) Entwicklung von Kampagnenstrategien auf Basis von Zielgruppenanalysen und Marktbeobachtung Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Ad-Creatives – statisch und videobasiert – eigenständig oder in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team Strukturiertes Testing von Zielgruppen, Creatives, Botschaften und Landingpages nach klarer Testlogik Regelmäßige Analyse der Kampagnenergebnisse und Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen Erstellung verständlicher KPI-Reportings zur internen Auswertung und Weiterentwicklung der Strategie Aktive Mitgestaltung der Gesamtmarketingstrategie von Finanzklar Qualifikation Stellenanforderungen – was du mitbringst Fachlich: Analytisches Denkvermögen – du erkennst Muster in Zahlen, ziehst logische Schlüsse und kannst Daten in Entscheidungen übersetzen Grundverständnis für digitales Marketing und Social Media – du weißt wie Plattformen wie Facebook und Instagram funktionieren Affinität zu digitalen Tools und Systemen – neue Software erschließt du dir schnell und eigenständig Erste Erfahrungen mit Meta Ads, Google Ads oder vergleichbaren Plattformen sind ein Plus – kein Muss Meta Blueprint Zertifizierung von Vorteil – aber kein Ausschlusskriterium Sauberes, fehlerfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift – Pflicht Kreativ: Gespür für visuelle Wirkung – du erkennst was Menschen anspricht und was nicht Fähigkeit, Werbebotschaften klar und zielgruppengerecht zu formulieren Grundkenntnisse in Design- oder Videotools (z.B. Canva, Adobe Express, CapCut) von Vorteil – oder die Bereitschaft, sie zu erlernen Interesse an Storytelling und der Frage warum bestimmte Inhalte funktionieren und andere nicht Persönlich: Hohe Eigenmotivation – du treibst dich selbst an, auch wenn niemand nachfragt Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Lernbereitschaft – du bist bereit, in kurzer Zeit viel aufzunehmen und anzuwenden Strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise – du arbeitest präzise, dokumentierst sauber und hältst dich an definierte Prozesse Offenheit für Feedback und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung Teamfähigkeit – du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung und Team zusammen und kommunizierst proaktiv Vorerfahrung im Performance Marketing Management ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist wer du als Mensch bist, nicht was auf deinem Lebenslauf steht. Benefits Was du bekommst Intensives Onboarding über ca. 6 Monate –

We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. jobs.title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (UK)
jobs.description: We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models. This is a remote, flexible and short-term project. Key Responsibilities: Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule. Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion. Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn. Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies. Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined. This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions. Qualifications: Registration: Registered radiologist in your country of practice with active license Experience: 3–10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus Knowledge: Strong grounding in thoracic anatomy and cross-sectional CT. Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in image review or measurement work. Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms. Prior imaging annotation experience is an advantage but not required. Language: Native or near-native written English. Legal Status: You will have the right to work in your country of residence. You will work as an independent contractor. Why Join Us? Flexible Work Arrangements: Part-time, remote and fully asynchronous. Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate, paid weekly. Professional Development: Hands-on experience in clinical AI development and medical imaging, shaping how AI systems localise and measure findings on CT. Reporting to: Tennis Technical Manager Tennis Technical Team member alongside Technical Manager, Technical Project Managers and Technical Leads Why Hawk-Eye & Why Tennis? Join us at Hawk-Eye and be part of an exhilarating journey through the world of sports events. Our operations teams play a crucial role in delivering high-quality experiences at major sporting events worldwide. These are the different areas that you can explore: Technical : Testing, improving and stress testing our systems to enhance the performance of our delivery across the tours. Creative : Working closely with TV directors and external broadcasters to provide statistics and storytelling of insights across tennis matches during live broadcasts. Operations : Reviewing, improving and strategising how we improve the efficiency of delivery across the globe. Projects: On-site management of our service delivery across the globe. Liaising with external stakeholders to organise our technical requirements to be ready and sites to be prepared for our arrival, and to deliver our services to the deadline of the events. Broadcast Production : Rigging and directing live TV broadcasts across the Masters 1000s ATP tour. » Who is the Tennis Technical Team? The Tennis Technical Team oversees all technical aspects of the department, including the planning and delivery of our technology at events, testing and roll out of new software releases and new products, and advising on hardware specifications. They also directly impact the long term product roadmaps for tennis through reporting bugs, feature requests and new ideas through to the Product and Development teams. As Data Lead you will fit in as part of the technical pillar within Tennis. At each event there is a Technical Guarantee whose role it is to oversee our full technical delivery including the delivery of our data - this includes the hardware and software set up of Hawk-Eye’s Tennis Data Platform on site. It is this data platform that you as Data Lead will oversee and manage from event to event, ensuring we are producing data that is not only accurate but also distributed in a timely fashion to all contracted clients, meeting all quality of service requirements and service level agreements. As part of the technical team you will also be regularly interacting with the Product team in order to report detailed findings on the Tennis Data Platform and to continuously move the product forward, ensuring that it is as easy to use as possible. You will also liaise with the Commercial team and Clients to understand all delivery requirements, new services & products requiring data feeds, and advise on the contractual commitments of Hawk-Eye’s data delivery. Equally you will play a pivotal role in educating the operations team to ensure they are best set up for success at every event. » What the job is all about The role is all about managing the day to day data services that we deliver across all our Tennis events that take place around the globe. jobs.title: Platform Engineer - AI and Internal Tooling
jobs.description: About Gattaca Gattaca is an engineering-driven crypto technology company based in London. We build and operate Titan, the largest block builder on Ethereum. We are venture backed and have been profitable for the past 3 years. Blockchains have created something genuinely new: a trustless, shared layer for financial instruments. For that to work at scale, the network needs infrastructure that can support extremely high throughput and sophisticated trading, while keeping the underlying system decentralised. That's what we build. Ultra-performant infrastructure that keeps decentralised networks efficient. The role This role exists to increase the operating leverage of Gattaca’s engineering team. You’ll sit within the Platform team and focus on the tools and systems around how we build software, operate production and access information internally. Some of that will be traditional developer tooling. Increasingly, a lot of it will involve finding useful ways to apply AI to workflows that previously required an engineer sitting in front of a terminal. There is a surprising amount of leverage available here. Our systems generate terabytes of data and our engineers can inspect almost every part of what happens inside them, but getting to that information often still requires knowing which database to query, dashboard to open or machine to inspect. The same is true of engineering workflows: useful context is spread across code, production systems, internal messaging, incident notes and individual engineers. We want to make all of that much easier to use. The job is to work out where better tooling can remove meaningful friction, then build it properly. Sometimes that will mean a simple internal application. Sometimes it will mean using AI to review code, investigate production issues, query internal data or automate repetitive engineering work. What you’d work on Your day-to-day work will span these main areas: AI-assisted engineering We want to use AI where it actually improves how we build and operate software. Code review is an obvious example, but there is much more scope around debugging, investigation, repository workflows and repetitive engineering work. A large part of this role will be working out where those systems are genuinely useful, choosing the right models and tools for the job, and building the infrastructure around them so they become part of normal engineering workflows rather than isolated experiments. Company knowledge and data Our systems generate terabytes of data, but getting useful information out of them still often requires knowing which database to query, dashboard to open or machine to inspect. You’ll help build a cleaner layer over that information so people across the company can answer questions without needing to understand where the underlying data happens to live. The same applies to internal knowledge spread across code, documentation, internal messaging, incident notes and dashboards. We want that context to be easier to find and use, while still making it possible to get down to the raw source when needed. Internal tooling You’ll build the tools that remove friction from how people at Gattaca work. That might mean improving CI and deployment workflows, building better interfaces around existing systems, or replacing a manual process with something simple and reliable. Operational automation Production systems generate a constant stream of information through alerts, logs, crashes and traces. Today, investigating an issue often means manually piecing together context from several places. We want to make that loop much tighter. If a builder panics overnight, an agent should eventually be able to gather the relevant logs, inspect the host and codebase, understand what happened and prepare a fix for an engineer to review. If an alert appears in our internal messaging we should be able to investigate it from there rather than starting again from scratch. Safe execution The more useful these tools become

jobs.title: Product Counsel, Data & Search
jobs.description: Our Mission Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all. About the Role We are seeking a Data Product counsel to lead the legal support for our teams securing and developing data to help power the next generation of frontier AI models and developing agentic search capabilities for our future products. You will work at the frontier of AI law, translating US and international legal regimes and regulations relating to the use of data for different model and product types and building these into actionable product roadmaps. You will also support our teams as they explore the evolution of agentic and search capabilities. You will be a strategic partner to cross-functional teams across a hyper-scaling AI lab, ensuring that our frontier open foundation models have access to essential data whilst being built responsibly. You will advise on US and international AI laws and regulations applicable to both the use of data and agentic frameworks. You will work closely with our product, research, engineering and safety teams as well as other business operations and compliance units to implement measures that ensure our models are responsibly developed. This is a high-impact, build-stage role. You will not simply answer one-off legal questions; you will help design the policies, review processes, escalation pathways, and business-facing guidance that allow Reflection to move quickly while maintaining a mature and defensible compliance posture. What You’ll Do Act as Reflection’s primary legal contact for our pre-training and data teams, advising on existing and developing laws and regulations that impact the acquisition and utilisation of data for AI training and development across Reflection’s product teams. Act as Reflection’s primary legal contact for agentic and search-based product proposals, advising on this evolving area of law and regulation. Provide focused legal advice relating to legal risks and compliance requirements relating to the use of data for AI training and development, including intellectual property, privacy, licensing and AI regulation. Design and implement data integrity standards and processes to manage risks relating to data use and acquisition. Advise on existing and developing US and international regulations relating to data use and development. Develop policies alongside the data and training teams to ensure Reflection’s models meet data provenance, tracking and usage requirements and standards. Help establish a risk-based compliance posture for AI-specific data requirements. Partner with cross functional teams to implement data controls that allow for responsible model releases and ensure Reflection addresses current and future data regulations and laws. Advise on data considerations in commercial and strategic transactions including partnerships with customers, data and model collaborations and research partnerships. Help support the building of agentic capabilities and advising the product teams on legal and compliance requirements including intellectual property, safety, security, privacy and AI regulation. Monitor legal and regulatory developments from Congress, the White House, the EU, UK, and other relevant authorities, and translate those developments into practical guidance for leadership and operators. Approximately 10+ years of experience product counselling and advising companies of legal risks in the technology sector, especially in sectors such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, semiconductors, advanced computing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data centers, or other strategically sensitive technologies. jobs.description: Content Platform is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and delivering every piece of content on Spotify — from music and podcasts to audiobooks. Within Content Platform, the Media domain owns the end-to-end media pipeline, from the moment content arrives through to seamless playback for listeners around the world. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale. What You'll Do Define and drive the long-term architectural direction for Spotify's media pipeline across Content Platform. Lead large-scale technical initiatives that span multiple squads and organizations, including projects such as media delivery, codec rollouts, and future playback capabilities. Partner closely with engineering managers, product managers, and senior engineers to align technical strategy with product priorities, reliability goals, and cost efficiency, acting as a key technical counterpart for media architecture. Guide architectural decisions across media ingestion, transcoding, packaging, storage, content delivery, and playback. Author and review RFCs, architecture decision records, and technical design documents that guide engineering teams and leadership. Mentor senior engineers across the organization, helping raise technical quality, architectural thinking, and engineering excellence. Bring a cost-aware engineering mindset by understanding how media architecture decisions impact compute, storage, CDN utilization, and long-term platform sustainability. Who You Are You have deep expertise building large-scale media platforms spanning audio, video, encoding, transcoding, packaging, delivery, and playback technologies. You have successfully led architecture across multiple engineering teams and influenced technical direction beyond your immediate organization. You have significant experience designing and operating distributed systems at internet scale, including high-throughput media processing, large-scale storage, and globally distributed delivery infrastructure. You understand the architectural trade-offs between codecs, packaging formats, playback technologies, storage, networking, and infrastructure costs. You have a strong track record of leading multi-quarter technical initiatives from initial proposal through implementation and organization-wide adoption. You communicate technical ideas clearly through well-structured RFCs, design documents, and architectural decision records. You build trust through collaboration and technical credibility, bringing together teams with different priorities to deliver shared outcomes. jobs.title: Senior National Account Manager
jobs.description: The Practical Detail Location: Hybrid | Remote Why this role matters In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide. What you'll do Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth. Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in. Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities. Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams. Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume. Performance You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth. Care You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change. Passion Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth. About you You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. One is building the platform and tooling that gets data scientists from experiment to production quickly. The other is keeping the production serving path fast, cheap and reliable as traffic grows. One person currently does both, and the reliability half loses whenever there's a modeling deadline. This role takes over that half. Why it's interesting: Scale is the problem we have. Work on the data layer under real-time serving. Redis comes first: access patterns, caching strategy, behavior when it degrades. Build a way to stress-test the platform end to end in staging so we find our ceiling before production does. Handle capacity planning and infrastructure cost as advertiser volume grows. Work closely with the data scientists shipping models into this stack, and with Benoît Delsart, who covers the platform and tooling side. Run incident response and make sure postmortems turn into changes that ship. Collaborate with other engineering teams, notably DSP, since our systems interact heavily with the rest of the stack. At ease debugging a p99 latency problem Observability experience: metrics, tracing, logs, and opinions about what makes an alert worth waking someone for. Infrastructure as code, CI/CD.
